name: Mass and output boundary
description: Feed-ingredient/commercial-feed mass as reported per tonne live output. Tacon moisture unspecified; no dry-matter normalization, wet-fish conversion or primary-crop conversion.

name: Source priority
description: 1995 FAO564, 1996-1999 interpolate to Tacon2015 2000; Tacon2015 2000-2009; Tacon2026 2010-2023. Never use publication projections as realized historical data.

name: Linear parameter interpolation
description: Interpolate p and eFCR separately; multiply afterward. Do not interpolate their product directly.

name: Early endpoint hold or explicit blank
description: Default holds 1995 p/eFCR and marine shares to 1973. Not a reconstruction of observed earlier farming. Config early_policy=blank leaves unsupported coefficients missing.

name: Marine inclusion interpolation
description: FAO564 1995/2000/2005/2007/2008 to Naylor2017 meal (wild+trimmings); later endpoint hold. Original marine-oil reference has a definition mismatch after 2008.

applies_to: oil for nine groups without new total-oil endpoint
name: Wild oil used as total proxy
description: Naylor oil is explicitly wild-fish oil. Missing trimming oil remains unknown, not zero. Total-oil proxy after 2008 can understate demand; flags retained.

name: Company total-oil endpoint
description: Interpolate FAO2008 total oil to Skretting2021 total oil, skipping wild-only Naylor oil. Hold 2021 onward. Company-to-global transfer is an assumption, not a global observation.

name: Generic conditional ratios
description: Fig5 undated illustrative profile used as fixed nonmarine proportions through 2015 (or all years where no recent proxy). 2015 is an implementation transition date, not an observation year. Shrimp 10% unlabeled mass remains unallocated OtherFeed.

applies_to: salmon, shrimp, tilapia nonmarine allocation after 2015
name: Company conditional-ratio transition
description: Linear ratio transition from Fig5 at 2015 to Skretting2021; hold thereafter. Adjust conditional ratios to 1 minus selected meal and oil. This constructs a hybrid recipe, not an observed global formulation.

name: Scope proxies
description: Older combined freshwater/diadromous group supplies earlier miscellaneous freshwater and pre2010 miscellaneous diadromous p/eFCR. Misc diadromous marine shares proxy misc freshwater. Mapping flags remain.

name: Missing trimming meal proxy
description: Naylor milkfish trimming meal blank is preserved in raw table; filled series assumes zero additional trimming meal to use the 2% wild-meal endpoint. Assumption, not measured zero.

name: Nonfed commercial grow-out
description: Silver and bighead carp assigned zero commercial-feed coefficient using Gephart2021 Table S5. Does not mean zero natural food, fertilizer or incidental pond inputs. Conditional eFCR and commercial-feed share remain undefined.

name: No arbitrary universal eFCR
description: Indian major carps, gastropods, reptiles and other unsupported pathways stay NA unless supported by an explicit mapping. A blank is not zero. Coverage is reported alongside partial totals.

name: 2021 species mixture transfer
description: Only for optional aggregate inputs lacking species_code: apply 2021 country-water-ISSCAAP mixture, with country/global fallbacks. Not used with the v0.6.1 default species-resolved history.

name: Global mixture alternative
description: Optional aggregate-input sensitivity only; disabled for the default species-resolved history because observed species weights are available.

name: No forced calibration
description: Compare published totals without fitting/rescaling p/eFCR. Tacon benchmark shares the model and is not independent. Industry factory output differs from consumption, geographic coverage, inventory and trade.

name: Group-level evidence mapped to species
description: Species codes provide the lookup interface. The original 547-code crosswalk is retained; 184 explicit historical additions bring coverage to 731. Most eFCR values remain proxies from 12 literature groups, not independent species measurements.

name: Commercial feed only
description: Estimate commercial compound feed; not all farm-made feed, direct whole fish, grazing or fertilizers. Noncommercial production is not necessarily biologically unfed.

name: Country reporting area not GCAM region
description: Use FAO reporting-area codes. No authoritative country-to-GCAM-region mapping was provided, so do not invent macroregional aggregates.

name: No mixing undocumented bases
description: Raw table uses within-source products only. Aas national composition is review-only. Skretting marine protein includes crustacean meal and is not equated with fishmeal. Literature correction audit for Naylor remains open.

name: Historical crosswalk extension
description: See docs/historical_species_mapping_additions.csv: reuse documented ISSCAAP and literal-name group proxies where specified; retain unsupported carp, charr, miscellaneous diadromous and other pathways as UNESTIMATED. Do not invent common names or infer a universal eFCR.

name: Coverage extension effective commercial-feed assumption
description: 2021 e=2.0; effective p*e=0.5; sensitivity 0.1 to 1.0 t/t. Rounded 2 t/t conditional eFCR and assumed p=0.25 at 2021. Source demonstrates feeding, not these global values. 95% crop is an assumed crop-dominant commercial recipe. Relative p and e trends from Chinese fed carps; recipe fixed. All selected central uptake values are assumptions, not observations.

name: Borrowed historical trend
description: For anchor-scaled groups e(t)=e2021*donor_e(t)/donor_e(2021); p(t)=min(1,(a2021/e2021)*donor_p(t)/donor_p(2021)). Fixed recipes hold by year; donor recipes use year-specific donor. Bounds multiply the combined effective input, not separately identified p/e. Early-policy hold or blank applies; trends are assumptions not reconstructed observations.

name: Numeric coverage not total feeding completeness
description: Complete means all input species have effective commercial-feed values under selected policy. Farm-made and direct wet fish/seaweed remain outside scope; original subtotal and extension reported separately; no fitting to Tacon grand total.
